reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address the effects of cold rolling, recovery annealing, grain orientation, or strain on magnetic anisotropy, domain wall mobility, or magnetocaloric hysteresis in FeMnNiGeSi-type HEAs. E1 discusses mictomagnetic states in inhomogeneous systems, and E2 discusses cost and entropy change in NiFeCoCr-based HEAs, neither supporting the key premises.
premises: Cold rolling and recovery anneal induce preferential grain orientation and residual strain fields in FeMnNiGeSi-type HEAs.
Induced texture and strain modify local magnetic anisotropy and exchange interactions.
Modified magnetic landscape enhances domain wall mobility.
Enhanced domain wall mobility broadens the magnetocaloric transition and reduces hysteresis.
